items.text: Never alter, double, or stop prescribed dosages without consulting the treating doctor or registered pharmacist. Call Tamil Nadu 104 Health Helpline for guidance.
Prescription codes: 1-0-1 AF means morning 1, night 1 after food. 1-0-0 BF means morning 1 before food. SOS means only when severe pain or fever occurs.
Metformin should always be taken with or immediately after meals to prevent gastric upset, nausea, and abdominal cramps.
Blood pressure medicines like Telmisartan or Amlodipine must be taken at the same fixed time daily; do not skip when blood pressure feels normal.
Levothyroxine must be taken first thing in the morning on an empty stomach with plain water, waiting at least 30 minutes before coffee, tea, or breakfast.
Paracetamol maximum daily adult dose is 4000mg. Do not combine with other cold remedies containing acetaminophen to prevent acute liver toxicity.
Iron / Ferrous sulfate tablets should be taken after food with water or citrus fruit; never take with milk, tea, or coffee as tannins inhibit absorption.
Antibiotics such as Amoxicillin must be completed for the full prescribed duration even if fever and symptoms subside to avoid drug resistance.
PMBJP Jan Aushadhi generic medicines contain the identical active pharmaceutical ingredient (API), strength, and therapeutic bioequivalence as branded equivalents at 50% to 90% lower cost.
Severe red flags including chest pain, breathlessness, loss of consciousness, poisoning, or allergic swelling require immediate emergency ambulance call to 108 or transfer to GRH Madurai Casualty.
